method: Every unsigned reviewer run of 12 or more tokens reported by tools/reference-overlap for the 02-56 shared modules was reviewed by two fresh-context Claude reviewers who did not write the code (side-by-side provenance and a skeptic who answers derived unless copying is ruled out). A run either lens did not mark generic was escalated to three more reviewers (idiom, provenance, skeptic) and signed off only when all three said generic with high confidence. Codex was unavailable until 2026-11-12 (OVERNIGHT-DECISIONS row 40). The owner may revoke any entry.
